cases.name: Eva Mae Fuld
cases.about:
She was a retired school teacher who taught French and Spanish and was described by friends in a Syracuse Post-Standard report as “kind” and “quirky". She worked for more than 30 years at Westmoreland High School.

Her obituary said, "She started her long teaching career and interrupted it long enough to study French at the Sorbonne and later, Spanish in Mexico City. She taught Languages at Westmoreland High School. After her long teaching career, she worked at Syracuse Library. She was an avid reader and enjoyed travel."

https://obits.syracuse.com/us/obituaries/syracuse/name/eva-fuld-obituary?pid=197650559

cases.name: Apreona Q. Harris
cases.about: Her obituary said, "Apreona was an enthusiastic vibrant young woman who attended Syracuse City Schools, she had a free spirt and aspirations of becoming an actor. She possessed many talents and was very creative. She had a heart of gold and loved to spread positivity amongst friends in family. She enjoyed movies, cooking, singing along with making people laugh. Throughout her childhood she was a member of the Greater New Testament Missionary Baptist Church but later became a member of The Church House of Levites. She will be remembered for her faith and spirituality and her passion for helping others. She was a bright star in a big sky and will be deeply missed."
cases.narrative: She was shot on 12/15 and her baby boy was delivered. She taken off life support on 12/20/2023.
